title: U.S. House · Pennsylvania's 1st District
area: Bucks County and part of Montgomery County, in the Philadelphia suburbs.

context.text: Brian Fitzpatrick won the May 19, 2026 Republican primary unopposed. Bob Harvie won the Democratic primary, defeating Lucia Simonelli.

positions.summary: In a February 2026 statement from his office after the Supreme Court tariff ruling, his spokeswoman said he opposes broad tariffs that raise costs for consumers.
positions.quote: the Congressman has always, and will always, oppose any broad tariffs that raise costs on the American consumer.

positions.summary: In December 2025 signed a discharge petition to force a House vote on extending enhanced ACA subsidies, and said expiration without a bridge was worse than a clean extension.
positions.quote: As I’ve stated many times before, the only policy that is worse than a clean three-year extension without any reforms, is a policy of complete expiration without any bridge

record.text: Introduced a bipartisan measure to bar members of Congress from profiting off earmarks (announced September 17, 2026).
Led a bipartisan effort to shield ratepayers from data center costs that passed the House (announced September 16, 2026).
Helped secure final passage of the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act (announced September 16, 2026).

candidates.name: Bob Harvie
candidates.ballotNote: Won the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary, defeating Lucia Simonelli.
candidates.currentRole: Chair, Bucks County Board of Commissioners

priorities.text: Wants to permanently restore and expand Affordable Care Act premium tax credits, lower the Medicare buy-in age from 65 to 55, and let Medicare negotiate prescription drug prices and cap insulin costs.
Supports a middle-class tax cut while ensuring large corporations and the ultra-wealthy "pay their fair share."
Wants to roll back tariffs he says raise consumer prices and raise the federal minimum wage to $15 per hour.
Supports overturning Citizens United, banning corporate PAC contributions, banning congressional stock trading, and a lifetime lobbying ban for former members of Congress.

positions.summary: Supports permanently restoring ACA premium tax credits, lowering the Medicare eligibility age to 55, and letting Medicare negotiate drug prices.
positions.quote: I'll fight to permanently restore and expand those tax credits so families don't wake up to hundreds of dollars in higher monthly premiums simply because Congress failed to act. I believe we need to lower the age that Americans can buy into Medicare from 65 to 55.

positions.summary: Supports a middle-class tax cut paid for by ensuring large corporations and the ultra-wealthy pay a higher share.
positions.quote: I'll fight for a middle class tax cut while ensuring large corporations and the ultra-wealthy pay their fair share so middle class Americans get a much needed tax cut.

positions.summary: Supports raising the federal minimum wage to $15 per hour.
positions.quote: For too long, the minimum wage in this country has remained stagnant. I believe we need to raise the minimum wage to $15 per hour.

positions.summary: Opposes the tariffs enacted under the Trump administration, saying they raise costs for food and household goods.
positions.quote: I will fight to roll back Trump's tariffs that unnecessarily increase the cost of food and household essentials for American consumers

positions.summary: Supports expanding clean energy and modernizing the electric grid, and criticized the 2025 reconciliation law for cutting clean-energy tax credits.
positions.quote: That's why I'll fight to expand clean energy, modernize our electric grid, and build resilient roads, bridges, and public transit systems that keep our economy moving.
